issues.title: Namespace authority duality
issues.evidence: wave authority has canonical_wave != canonical_wave_key for 8/35 waves; persisted response binding uses a mixed display/key dialect
issues.root_cause: Human labels simultaneously serve display, lookup key, and machine identity roles.

issues.title: Hybrid source/question-structure namespace
issues.evidence: Current QSR differs from authority display for 6/35 objects: Arab 4 plus EVS 1981 and 1999; source-structure manifest is itself hybrid.
issues.root_cause: Independent upstream canonicalizer copied literally into generated authority.

issues.title: Resolver proliferation and routing bypass
issues.scope: survey identity, QRA, source validator, shard builder, family overlay, response semantics
issues.evidence: At least six independent or partially independent normalization/routing mechanisms govern the same object namespace.

issues.title: Binding-corpus branch publication divergence
issues.evidence: Active 35-wave QRA CSV is on main and runtime branch; full companion binding corpus including wave authority is on runtime branch/upload but not main.
issues.root_cause: Authority publication is incomplete on main, not QRA absence.

issues.title: CLOSED_35 scope is not enforced at general V550 planning/execution boundaries
issues.evidence: Asian Barometer W6 is present in discovery/structure authority; ddm_survey_identity resolves it; V550 planner discovers DB/template source-wave cells without consulting CLOSED_35. The official smoke wrapper rejects W6, but general planning/execution does not share that gate.
issues.root_cause: Identity resolution/discovery and production authorization are separate concerns, but current general V550 entrypoints do not carry the governed-membership decision.

issues.title: Alias-tolerant retrieval feeds label-sensitive object identity
issues.evidence: Lookup paths accept aliases, then hashes/IDs/group keys use the selected literal source/wave label.
issues.root_cause: Resolver output is a label rather than a stable object identifier.

issues.title: Execution and replay identity are label-derived
issues.evidence: Shard IDs, partition paths, question checkpoint keys, replay contract hashes, and lineage tokens depend on literal wave spelling.

issues.title: Exact boundary contracts validate spelling, not governed object identity
issues.scope: V551→V552J boundary manifests and shared consumer
issues.evidence: Strict exact identity is correctly enforced, but the exact key is source/wave text rather than wave_uid.
issues.root_cause: CF001 exactness is implemented over labels.

issues.title: Database keys remain label-native
issues.evidence: QSM primary key is (source,wave,var_code); view uses literal q.wave=r.wave and canonical_wave=r.wave.
issues.root_cause: DB is an independent identity island.
